description: The baseline object inside the ingest or import closure record. state.md#2.8 states its contents in prose, not as a field list: the integration head it was measured on; any earlier release tag; the suite result with the identities of the tests that failed; the lint and format
x-note: findings; the mutation score per module; the scanner findings in existing dependencies; the recovered or imported contract ids; and whether the project has a suite, a JUnit report and CI. BLUEPRINT.md#4.13 lists: the tests that failed then, lint, format and scanner findings,
mutation scores per module, and the recovered contract set. The design gives no key names, no types and no required list, so this schema names none.
